principle: Refusal at F8 is structural, not advisory. Every world-input family that cannot be licensed terminates in a typed state or raises; none silently degrades to context, zero, or confidence.

refusal_families.trigger: PositionedSubjectPossibilityQuery.purpose != EMPIRICAL_POSSIBILITY_ONLY
ConditionerBinding without positive comparability_authority_ref
conditioner_bindings whose source_universe_ref or release_ref differs from the query
refusal_families.mechanism: raises 'conditioner source/release mismatch; no implicit bridge'

refusal_families.trigger: any identifier equal to latest | default | nearest | fuzzy | *
refusal_families.note: No latest/default/fuzzy/fallback resolution is lawful anywhere in the F8 seam.
refusal_families.evidence: source_backed_positioned_subject_possibility.py:_text; OBL031 adoption 'No latest/default/fuzzy/fallback grammar resolution is lawful'

refusal_families.trigger: query.source_universe_ref not in rule.source_universe_refs
walkback step whose source_universe_ref or release_ref differs from the query
refusal_families.mechanism: FAIL_CLOSED / FAIL_CLOSED_UNAUTHORIZED_PROXY_SOURCE, reason 'V1 proxies may not cross source universe or release'
refusal_families.note: Backs the frozen rule field cross_source_proxy = FORBIDDEN_IN_V1.

refusal_families.trigger: walkback ladder that does not strictly decrease retained_conditioner_ids
refusal_families.mechanism: raises 'walkback ladder must strictly decrease specificity'

refusal_families.trigger: walkback step proxy authority not present in positive_proxy_authority_refs
refusal_families.mechanism: raises 'every walkback step needs positively listed proxy authority'

refusal_families.trigger: more than one PossibilitySliceEvidence at the same source/release/target/specificity
refusal_families.mechanism: raises 'duplicate evidence at exact source/release/target/specificity grain'

refusal_families.trigger: evidence_state == SUPPORTED and geometry is None
refusal_families.note: Prevents a distribution-free assertion from being typed as support.

refusal_families.trigger: any attempt to let proxy support resolve an exact request
refusal_families.mechanism: rule field proxy_can_satisfy_exact_request = False; result state is EXACT_UNRESOLVED_PROXY_AVAILABLE with exact_lane.disposition = UNRESOLVED

refusal_families.trigger: renormalization_requested = True at any objective-consumer seam
refusal_families.note: This is the single refusal that makes CONTEXT_ONLY safe. It forbids a world fact that merely accompanies a result from tightening or rescaling the distribution.

refusal_families.trigger: requested ceiling exceeds an input's declared ceiling
refusal_families.note: POPULATION_STATISTIC and SOURCE_LOCAL_STATISTIC can satisfy only themselves; STRUCTURAL_RELATION and OBJECTIVE_FACT require exact self-identity. There is no arithmetic path from a population fact to a structural or positioned-subject claim.

refusal_families.trigger: required input unavailable
no input satisfies the requested ceiling
refusal_families.note: Explicitly prevents an absent gate from being reported as a legitimate scoped success.

refusal_families.family: non-empirical or relation-typed input without its authority
refusal_families.trigger: NON_EMPIRICAL_MODEL evidence, or relation authority absent

interpretation_or_transformation_semantics containing GENERATED_ACTOR_POSITION, GENERATED_NINE_STRATUM_POSITION, ACTOR_BELIEF, ACTOR_PERSONA, ACTOR_PSYCHE, ACTOR_MEMORY, ACTOR_KNOWLEDGE, ACTOR_RESPONSE, or DIAGNOSTIC_SCORE_AS_STRUCTURAL_FACT
refusal_families.note: Enforces STRUCTURAL_PRESSURE != INDIVIDUAL_DESIRE and OBJECTIVE_WORLD_TIME != ACTOR_MEMORY at the point of rule creation, not by guidance.

refusal_families.trigger: rule.required_authority_bindings lacking TARGET_USE_PERMISSION
refusal_families.mechanism: raises 'rule must bind exact TARGET_USE_PERMISSION authority'

refusal_families.family: time- or measure-scoped rule lacking its conditional authority
refusal_families.trigger: time-scoped rule without TEMPORAL_EVIDENCE, or measure/estimand-scoped rule without WEIGHT_DESIGN_ESTIMAND

refusal_families.family: structural source not applicable to structural use
refusal_families.trigger: P06 decision SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE_TO_STRUCTURAL_USE
refusal_families.note: This is the only current source-applicability authority, and it VALIDATES rather than SELECTS. See H-C.

refusal_families.family: empirical fact noncomparable / temporal scope mismatch
refusal_families.trigger: P06 decisions EMPIRICAL_FACT_NONCOMPARABLE, TEMPORAL_SCOPE_MISMATCH
refusal_families.mechanism: public states NONCOMPARABLE and OUT_OF_SCOPE respectively

refusal_families.trigger: rule.negative_authority_only is true
refusal_families.mechanism: cannot reach ADMITTED; resolves to ADMISSION_DENIED

refusal_families.trigger: lifecycle selection state UNKNOWN_CURRENTNESS or CONFLICTING_CURRENT_SELECTION
refusal_families.note: Enforces CURRENT_FACT != HISTORICAL_FACT. A historical exact ref is not a valid current fact, and unknown currentness never defaults to current.

refusal_families.trigger: evaluating OC03, OC04 or OC05
refusal_families.note: OC03 reason: 'P1-P5 remain CANDIDATE_NOT_CURRENT'. OC05 reason: 'terminal objective-world root/resolver is not current; no universal terminal may be invented'.

refusal_families.trigger: replayed result_hash or material differs from expected

refused_inputs_structurally_unable_to_be: any realized actor state, biography or personality
a same-respondent jointness claim across sources
an interpolated period presented as an observation
a causal attribution of a temporal break
an individual-level change inferred from a field trajectory
a population or source-local statistic read as a positioned-subject attribute
an unresolved or non-comparable input read as a confident output
contradictory cross-source relations averaged into one value
